name: 왕의 회랑
layout: Five individually authored chambers using 25 solid two-sided triangular prisms with a raised central ridge and outward-facing 55-degree slopes. Either face remains connected through turns and aligned gap transfers, with no compulsory left/right swaps. Broad shared landings, widened physical apertures, four recovery checkpoints, dives, spiral turns and aerial launches remain.
physics: Unchanged original surf profile; 4.5 m/s ground movement, no sprint, no automatic bunny hop, no scripted player boost.
